thread:
alex: Hey team — just discovered a memory spike in embeddings service in prod after the 1.2.3 roll. Repro in staging. Need a hotpatch, planning a small fastpatch window (15m). Can we get expedited signoff to accelerate deploy and limit canary?

sara: Ack. What's the proposed plan? :eyes:

mike: tagging infra — any infra constraints for a mid-rollout pin or fast rollback?

julia_ops: Checklist: release note stub, rollback playbook link, config pin, and no DB migrations. If those hold, ops +1 for fast path.

alex: Plan: build hotfix image hotfix-1.2.3.1, run canary to 5% for 5m, then 50% for 5m, then 100% if metrics stable. If we get unanimous ops + eng, I want to shorten the canary times to 2m/5m to hit the 15m window. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% OR p95 latency +30% over baseline. Fallback image pinned: v1.2.2.

eric_oncall: I'm on pager. I can watch metrics. Quick question: can we skip DB migration check? There are none, right?

sara: No migrations. E2E tests in staging passed after fix. I ran a quick local load and KV cache looks fine. :white_check_mark:

mike: infra: GPUs/serving pools healthy in eu-west1 and us-west1. No capacity blocks. We can shorten canary if ops confirms observability hooks are ready.

alex: ops, can you confirm telemetry dashboards + alert hooks are armed? I need explicit go to cutover.

julia_ops: Telemetry: dashboards linked (https://dashboards.redwood/team/embeddings/hotpatch-1739990000). Alerts set: embed-errors, embed-latency, mem-surge. Oncall Eric will get immediate alerts. I'm +1 for 2m canary then 5m at 50% then ramp to 100% if green.

eric_oncall: I'll be at my desk. If I see alert within the window I'll call rollback and start postmortem triage. :telephone_receiver:

sara: I'm fine with shortened canary. Approving expedited. :thumbsup:

mike: infra +1. No infra objections.

alex: Cool. Locking in decision. Performing deploy now. Command sent to deploybot.

deploy-bot: COMMAND RECEIVED from alex: ```/deploy service=embeddings image=hotfix-1.2.3.1 canary=5% canary_duration=2m next=50% next_duration=5m fallback=v1.2.2 note="hotfix memory spike"```

deploy-bot: Starting canary — eu-west1 (5%) at 1739990015. Canary window 2m. Tracking metrics: https://dashboards.redwood/team/embeddings/hotpatch-1739990000

sara: watching e2e traces and logs. No anomalies so far.

julia_ops: tagging release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/1739990000-hotfix (stub created, will fill post-cut)

eric_oncall: 1m in — p95 latency stable, no errors.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 50% at 1739990035. Next window 5m.

sara: 3m into 50% — still green. Rolling to 100% in 2m unless objections.

mike: infra metrics normal. No KV pressure spikes.

eric_oncall: No alerts. Green from oncall.

alex: Rolling to 100% now. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100% at 1739990105. Observability will continue for 15m.

julia_ops: Release notes updated and change window logged. I'll open a quick follow-up thread for root cause postmortem if anything crops up.

sara: Thanks everyone. Marking as expedited-approved. I'll paste final CI artifact and test snippets in the follow-up.

alex: Great job team. If anyone sees anything, ping #incidents and call the oncall.
